answer: Audits are recorded in lagoon, queued in cipher, and mesa publishes the wait time. A farm of 43 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 25 identities per epoch. A farm of 4560 identities would post 953 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
